findings.title: claude_cli reviewer 'binary' override lets any scripted executable count as an independent reviewer for a real milestone
Evidence is trusted from state.json; an edited verdict reaches VERIFIED and verify() reports no error
Driver's repair commit runs worker-planted git hooks: out-of-scope and protected files are committed after the scope check and regression proof
pytest/flutter gate passes when the run crashes or collects nothing (exit code and missing junit ignored)
Qualification gates run in the candidate worktree without checking it is clean, so uncommitted (or ignored) files decide the VERIFIED result
Worker process group is only killed on timeout; detached children keep running after the post-run integrity checks
Revert after a refused repair leaves staged new files in the index
Regression-proof timeout is uncaught: driver crashes mid-FIXING and leaves the implementer's changes unreverted
effective_verdict is lenient on malformed severity/blocking fields
DEVTEST classification by '_TEST' substring lets a scripted reviewer count for real milestones whose names contain _TEST
Gate timeouts do not kill child process trees
Docs claim guarantees the code does not provide
Forged duplicate round record plus edited resume_to brings a real milestone to VERIFIED; verify() reports no error
Worker-created git replace refs hide a protected-path change from every driver check; it is committed and pushed to canonical
Revert after a refused repair is not limited to the implementation worktree: a rewritten .git gitfile makes reset --hard move the main checkout's branch
Repair that deletes a test file crashes regression_proof; the unproven repair commit stays and is adopted as the candidate
GPU lease busy (gpu_lease run exit 75) is classified as a gate failure and routed to repair, not BLOCKED (RESOURCE)
A baseline-passing test that is skipped on the candidate is not detected by the gate comparison
Unknown integration mode is not rejected and pushes the candidate without the fast-forward check
Integration merge/merge-base/push bypass the hooks-disabled git wrapper
Revert after a refused repair resets whatever branch the implementation worktree's HEAD names: a redirected HEAD makes the driver move another branch (incl. the main checkout's) to the candidate SHA
A non-COMPLETED baseline gate result (TIMED_OUT, GPU lease busy, BLOCKED) is cached by SHA+cmd and permanently blocks qualification
Candidate moved during VERIFYING/VERIFIED blocks with resume_to=VERIFYING, so every resume re-blocks and the new commit is never re-audited
Milestone policy (protected-path authorisation, gates, integration authorisation, reviewer) is re-read every run; a changed config is only logged, so any writer can relax policy mid-milestone
Docs understate state-forging: an append-only forge suffices, and setsid-escaped worker writes outside the worktree are not caught

Policy binding covers only the config file hash: the default protected list (ws_frozen_check) is re-read every run from the main checkout's working tree and a relaxed list reaches VERIFIED with no CONFIG_CHANGED and verify() clean
A baseline-passing test newly skipped in the candidate is not a gate regression (and satisfies a gate-finding regression proof)
LIFECYCLE_QUALIFICATION.md ends at R1: refers to 'R2 below' that does not exist and still states 114 passed
Gate-finding repairs skip the fail-before proof for class-based pytest tests and every Flutter test: a repair that weakens the failing test is committed and integrated
Baseline comparison keys are non-deterministic: plain-assert causes include run-specific values and Flutter load-failure ids include the absolute worktree path, so historical failures count as new
